title: Machu Picchu
text:
Machu Picchu is in Peru. It is very old. It is on top of a mountain. Many tourists visit it every year.

The city has many stone walls. People can walk on the old paths. The views are beautiful. You need a ticket to enter.

questions.text: What do you need to enter the city?
Why do many tourists visit Machu Picchu?
options: Because it is beautiful and old
Because it is in their city
Because it is a small shop

questions.text: Why is a ticket needed to visit the city?
options: Because it is a special place
Because it is free for everyone

vocabulary.definition: having existed for a long time
a very high area of land
people who travel to visit other places
a small paper that allows you to enter a place

paragraph_translations: Machu Picchu está en Perú. Es muy antiguo. Está encima de una montaña. Muchos turistas lo visitan cada año.
La ciudad tiene muchas paredes de piedra. Las personas pueden caminar por los caminos antiguos. Las vistas son hermosas. Necesitas un boleto para entrar.
